method: Country-specific piecewise anchor histories. Annual ratings are project-authored derived estimates; direct facts stay in normalized observation datasets and are temporally gated.
evidence_rules: Davis Cup outcomes are limited to competition/tradition context and never reused as participation, access or development/support measurements.
France uses federation scale only for modern popularity/access and DTN/high-performance milestones for development/support.
LTA evidence is explicitly partial for Earth GBR because Northern Ireland is outside LTA jurisdiction; it must not be presented as a full United Kingdom participation census.
Argentina current federation counts are used only from 2026; DETA is selected-cohort development/support evidence, not nationwide participation or guaranteed outcomes.
Japan preserves the 2001 national-training-base setback and 2008 recovery; its 2017-2021 top-100 retrospective is only complete from 2021 onward.
Japan's current participation decline and school outreach remain dimension-specific; declining participation is not treated as declining innate player potential.
No held-out validation ranking is used to tune the authored values.
